messages.content: Write one short note to the chair reporting this delegation's explanation of the vote. Use only this annex summary. Keep the reasons, institutional preferences and geographic and policy scope. Name the delegation and clearly distinguish what it said from a Council decision. Supply the explanation only, in at most 55 words.

{"delegation": "Russian Federation", "source": "Russia opposed the draft's generic, automatic link between climate change and security. It preferred substantive climate work through specialist forums, principally the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC), and an alternative draft addressing the Sahel's specific circumstances and multiple sources of insecurity."}

{"delegation": "India", "source": "India opposed shifting climate decisions from the universal, consensus-based UNFCCC to the Security Council, where it argued that most developing countries lack a voice. It recognized that climate pressures may exacerbate conflicts in the Sahel and supported a draft limited to that region."}

{"delegation": "China", "source": "China abstained. It favored country-specific Council consideration of climate risks in peace and security rather than treating climate change as the main security challenge everywhere. It emphasized common but differentiated responsibilities and called for developed countries to fulfill financing, technology transfer and capacity-building commitments."}
